title: Public-sector workers picket Ministry of Public Service over salary-review delays
location: Outside Ministry of Public Service, Mbabane
scope: Single reported picket outside the ministry; reports do not establish a multi-city episode.
organizer: Public Sector Unions (PSUs); several participating unions are reported, but the complete organizer list is not established in the retained evidence.

state_target.target: Government of Eswatini, specifically the Ministry of Public Service and salary-review implementation/report process
state_target.evidence: The picket was outside the ministry and sought release/implementation of the government's salary-review report.

demands_original: Workers sought progress on the government salary review and objected to delay in the report/process.
participants_original: More than 300 public-sector workers (EU SEE); local Observer issue independently confirms workers were present but returned passage has no count.
threshold_50_evidence: EU SEE reports more than 300 picketers at the Mbabane ministry; contemporaneous local Observer issue confirms workers were outside the ministry. The count is source-attributed, not independently quantified by the Observer.

start_date.summary: EU SEE dates the picket to July 2, 2025.

end_date.summary: Report says the picket continued through that day; no end time is reported.

location.summary: Both sources locate workers outside the Ministry of Public Service in Mbabane.

scope.summary: Evidence describes a ministry picket in Mbabane, with no basis to aggregate it with other actions.

organizer.summary: Public-sector workers/unions organized the picket; exact affiliates not fully preserved in the concise outcome.

state_target.summary: Reported grievance is delayed government salary review and report.

demands.summary: Demand concerns public-sector salary-review process and implementation.

participants_original.summary: EU SEE reports more than 300 participants; local page confirms presence but no count.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Source-attributed estimate exceeds 300 at one named gathering; second local account confirms workers present but not the count.

protester_violence.summary: EU SEE characterizes picket as peaceful; no violence by protesters is reported.

state_response.summary: Police disruption and a government commitment are mentioned in concurrent negotiations, but specific response to gathering is unclear; category values remain unknown.

notes: Candidate only; do not treat the concurrent Joint Negotiation Forum government commitment as a causal response to the picket. Facebook link on EU SEE page was not opened.
open_questions: Independent corroboration of attendance estimate, if available.
Whether any police action was directly caused by the gathering; no response categories coded.

title: Siteki residents and public-sector unions protest water shortages and bills
location: Eswatini Water Services Corporation regional office, Siteki (exact event date conflicting)
scope: One reported action at a utility office; no broader episode established.
organizer: Public-sector unions and some Siteki residents, according to Times of Eswatini.

state_target.target: EWSC regional office; relation to government policy is not established in the report
state_target.evidence: The source describes complaints to a utility technician about interruptions and high bills, but does not establish a demand directed to government policy.

demands_original: Complaints over water interruptions and high bills.
threshold_50_evidence: No on-site number or qualitative attendance estimate was reported; threshold not established.

start_date.summary: Article chronology conflicts: dated July 19, says 'yesterday', and separately refers to Thursday July 3.

end_date.summary: No closure or end date reported.

location.summary: Times places residents/unions at the EWSC regional office in Siteki.

scope.summary: One local visit/protest at a utility office is described.

state_target.summary: Immediate addressee appears to be EWSC; government-policy link is not stated.

protester_violence.summary: Protester violence not reported; status unknown rather than inferred absent.

state_response.summary: The report describes a corporate/utility response, not a coded state response.

notes: Keep date disagreement explicit; do not infer which article reference is the actual protest date or infer EWSC is a government target.
open_questions: Resolve event date if possible without treating the two conflicting references as a verified day.
Attendance threshold and any simultaneous assembly size.
Whether the demand was directed at the Eswatini government or only utility management.

title: Women’s coalition protests US deportation arrangement and petitions at US Embassy
scope: One reported protest/petition action; no evidence of further locations.
organizer: Coalition of women’s rights groups (specific complete roster not retained).

state_target.target: Dual target: US authorities over deportation policy and Eswatini government over approval/legal basis and costs
state_target.evidence: Local article reports demands to both US and Eswatini authorities; it is not solely a foreign-government grievance.

demands_original: Reassess the US deportation policy/recall deportees; Eswatini authorities should disclose who approved the transfer, its legal basis, and government payments/plans.
threshold_50_evidence: The article describes a coalition protest and petition but gives no count; 50 simultaneous attendees are not established.

start_date.summary: Photo caption identifies the protest date as July 18.

end_date.summary: No event end or closure is reported.

location.summary: Report locates the petition/protest at the US Embassy in Mbabane.

organizer.summary: A coalition of women’s rights groups is named; roster details limited.

state_target.summary: Article reports both US-directed demands and demands that Eswatini government disclose legal authority and approval.

demands.summary: Foreign deportation-policy and domestic accountability demands are both reported.

participants_original.summary: No numerical or qualitative turnout provided.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Threshold is unestablished; no count appears in report.

protester_violence.summary: No information on protester violence; status unknown.

state_response.summary: No response by either government is reported.

notes: Do not code the US-only demand as a domestic target; the domestic accountability component is reported but whether it independently motivated the public action needs reviewer scrutiny.
open_questions: Relative role of domestic Eswatini demand versus US-targeted grievance.
